name: Renew
overview: Scripture teaches that renewal is a vital aspect of the Christian life, involving both spiritual strength and transformation. Isaiah 40:31 highlights that those who wait on the Lord will experience renewed strength, enabling them to persevere without weariness. Romans 12:2 emphasizes the renewing of the mind as essential for discerning and living out God's perfect will, while Romans 8:1 assures believers of freedom from condemnation when they walk according to the Spirit. Philippians 4:13 further affirms that Christ empowers believers to endure and accomplish all things through His strength.
